Type=simple
Restart=always
ExecStart={ path=/usr/local/bin/ngrok ; argv[]=/usr/local/bin/ngrok start host-a-ssh --config /etc/ngrok.yml ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
User=ngrok
Group=ngrok
Id=ngrok-host-a.service
Requires=system.slice -.mount sysinit.target
Wants=network-online.target tmp.mount
BindsTo=
RequiredBy=
After=-.mount system.slice ssh.service sysinit.target network-online.target systemd-tmpfiles-setup.service tmp.mount systemd-journald.socket basic.target
Description=ngrok TCP endpoint for host-a
LoadState=loaded
ActiveState=active
SubState=running
FragmentPath=/etc/systemd/system/ngrok-host-a.service
DropInPaths=
UnitFileState=enabled
UnitFilePreset=enabled
NeedDaemonReload=no
ConditionResult=yes

User=
Group=
Id=ssh.socket
Requires=system.slice sysinit.target
Wants=
BindsTo=
RequiredBy=
After=system.slice sysinit.target
Description=OpenBSD Secure Shell server socket
LoadState=loaded
ActiveState=inactive
SubState=dead
FragmentPath=/lib/systemd/system/ssh.socket
DropInPaths=
UnitFileState=disabled
UnitFilePreset=enabled
NeedDaemonReload=no
ConditionResult=no
